technical.summary: Mixed bullish structure (price above key MAs, supertrend, Ichimoku) undermined by weak momentum confirmation (MACD bearish, OBV flat, stochrsi overbought) and low trend strength (ADX 19.1); moderate risk/reward for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: MPC shows no fundamental conviction signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 34 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (16/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news sentiment limit conviction; neutral composite signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (321.12) indicates extreme market stress, rising DXY pressures energy multinationals, and earnings in 34 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above 200-EMA with supertrend bullish and Ichimoku cloud support provides structural bullish alignment, while extreme fear (16/100) presents classic contrarian opportunity in oversold conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 321.12, rising DXY), absent momentum confirmation (MACD bearish, OBV flat, stochrsi overbought), weak trend strength (ADX 19.1), zero fundamental conviction, and earnings event risk in 34 days create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure shows price above key MAs with supertrend bullish support, and extreme fear sentiment (16/100) presents contrarian opportunity. However, severe macro headwinds, absent momentum confirmation, and earnings event risk in 34 days create unacceptable risk/reward asymmetry for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve + VIX crisis (321.12) + rising DXY create macro environment hostile to energy multinationals; earnings in 34 days adds binary event risk that could gap through technical levels.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already 6 open Energy positions; adding MPC increases sector concentration risk during macro stress without fundamental or momentum conviction to justify it.
